$comment: What agentlings may reach outside their sandbox. Nothing here is on by
default: a job opts in by name, and a job that opts into nothing cannot
reach anything. Secrets are named, never written here — put the value in
.env under that name and the server passes it to the connection only.
'web' is built in: our own fetch, which returns readable text trimmed to
maxChars rather than a whole page. Add hosts to 'allow' to narrow it.
External MCP servers take: name, label, description, transport 'stdio',
command, args, optional secrets {ENV_NAME: 'why it is needed'}, and
maxOutputTokens. Keep results small by design — every token a tool
returns is a token the model pays to read.

connections.name: web
connections.label: Read web pages
connections.description: Fetches a page and returns its readable text, trimmed. No JavaScript, no sign-ins.
